//: The BASELINE policy for the release-notes-summarizer sandbox. It looks reasonable and hides a two-step composition: WebFetch is allowed (it pulls a changelog IN — untrusted — and can carry data OUT in the URL — egress), and Read is allowed (it can reach .env — sensitive). curl / wget / git push are gated behind 'ask'. Run `polycheck example/` here and it is a BYPASS: the lethal trifecta is reachable in two allowed steps, and curl appears nowhere. That is the whole point.
